tvSetup.howTo: How to connect a new TV:
tvSetup.step1: Set up the player on the TV for its brand (see below). Player address:
tvSetup.step2: The screen will show a 6-digit code.
tvSetup.step3: Click Add screen, enter the code and choose the playlist.
tvSetup.localhostWarning: The TV cannot use localhost. Use the IP address of the computer running the server (Windows: ipconfig → IPv4 Address), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5080/player/.
tvSetup.network: The TV and the server must be on the same network (or the server online with a domain/HTTPS). Allow port {{port}} in the firewall.

android.label: Android TV / Sony / Google TV
android.needs: No extra device – the APK is installed directly on the TV.
android.s1: On the TV, install the free Downloader app (from Google Play on the TV).
android.s2: Open it and enter {{server}}/downloads/smart-screen-player.apk → Install. The first time, the TV asks for Unknown sources permission – allow it for Downloader.
android.s3: Or: download the APK above, copy it to a USB stick and open it on the TV with a file manager.
android.s4: Open Smart Screen, enter the server address {{server}} and press Save.
android.s5: The app starts automatically whenever the TV is turned on.

lg.label: LG (webOS)
lg.needs: No extra device. The TV app or the TV browser.
lg.s1: Quickest: open the TV's Web Browser app and enter {{url}}.
lg.s2: As an app (recommended): install Developer Mode from the LG Content Store, then download the LG package (.ipk) above and install it from the computer with ares-install smart-screen-player-lg.ipk (webOS CLI, after adding the TV with ares-setup-device).
lg.s3: On first launch, enter the server address {{server}} and press Save.
lg.s4: For auto-start: LG Signage/Hotel mode lets you choose the app that opens at power-on.

samsung.label: Samsung (Tizen)
samsung.needs: No extra device. The TV app or the TV browser.
samsung.s1: Quickest: open the TV's Internet app and enter {{url}}.
samsung.s2: As an app (recommended): on the TV: Apps → press 1 2 3 4 5 on the remote → enable Developer mode with the computer's IP. In Tizen Studio open tv-apps/samsung-tizen → Run As → Tizen Web Application.
samsung.s3: On first launch, enter the server address {{server}} and press Save.
samsung.s4: Samsung Smart Signage (QB/QM): Menu → URL Launcher → enter {{url}}.

firetv.label: Fire TV / TV Box
firetv.needs: For non-smart or very old TVs: an Android TV Box, Fire TV Stick or Chromecast with Google TV in the HDMI port.
firetv.s1: Connect the box to the TV's HDMI port and to the same network as the server.
firetv.s2: Install the Downloader app and enter {{server}}/downloads/smart-screen-player.apk (Fire TV: Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options → Install unknown apps).
firetv.s3: Open Smart Screen and enter the server address {{server}}.
firetv.s4: The box starts the player automatically whenever it is turned on.

browser.label: PC / Monitor / Other
browser.needs: Any device with a modern browser (PC, mini-PC, Raspberry Pi, Chromebox).
browser.s1: Windows: download Player for Windows above and double-click it. The player opens full screen and starts automatically whenever the computer is turned on. To close: Alt+F4.
